content.short: Australians trade 400+ assets on Swyftx, which serves individuals, SMSFs and companies and builds in tax reporting.
content.description: Swyftx is registered with AUSTRAC and serves customers across Australia and New Zealand. Users trade a long list of assets, set up recurring buys, and get tax reports built in, which matters for local filing. Self-managed super funds and companies can open accounts too, and leveraged CFDs are offered through partner Eightcap. Customer assets are held one to one in fully reserved custody. It is Australian owned and operated, lists more than 410 assets and reports over 1.2 million users across Australia and New Zealand. Features include auto invest and crypto bundles for spreading money across several coins.
